definitions: An act of grabbing or seizing something suddenly.
A short period of time spent doing something.
A small fragment or scrap of something, such as music or conversation.
A weightlifting exercise where the bar is raised from the floor to overhead in one motion.
A vulgar slang term for the female genitals.
examples: A quick snatch at the ball.
I managed snatches of sleep on the train.
I heard snatches of their conversation.
He failed his final snatch attempt.
